empirical_sensitivity_source: Figure 2 digitized central curve, separately compared
rmse_weighting: Equal weight for each shared available H level inside the observed empirical range
scenario_aggregation: Minimum of seven whole-curve RMSE values at each parameter combination; never a different scenario at each H
domain_policy: Same H levels for all species, scenarios and parameters; no unavailable responses or endpoints substituted
interpolation: Piecewise linear Delaunay interpolation separately for each scenario on unit-normalized log10 parameter coordinates, followed by the scenario minimum; no extrapolation outside the sampled convex hull
presentation: Continuous fit-quality surfaces; no isolated optimal marker or arbitrary binary good-fit region
interpretation: Exploratory response-shape comparison on 128 sampled model profiles and 20 landscape seeds; no true species parameters or confidence region inferred
